cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The office clock is dragging us backward. Excellent, we can attend the meeting we missed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Too far. I haven't received the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Extra preparation time. This clock understands workload.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's before the booking. The boss wants my opinion: do we need this meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Tell her no. We've upgraded from attending on time to giving everyone their afternoon back.
